esp32.detail: 4 pins wired; M5Stack Unit 4Relay (4x 10 A relays, I2C) needs at least 5 V, so it is powered from 5 V. Added a 4.7 kΩ resistor from SDA to 3V3, as the datasheet's circuit requires. Added a 4.7 kΩ resistor from SCL to 3V3, as the datasheet's circuit requires. It shares the I2C bus (SDA D21, SCL D22) at address 0x26. Added the unit_4relay.py driver written from the datasheet.
Relays 1 and 3 switch on and off over I2C and read back: passes
